system.name: Passwall
system.description:
This spell opens a tunnel through a stone wall, ceiling, or floor by making the stone disappear. The tunnel is 5' wide and tall, and 10' long.

At the end of the duration, the stone re-appears and the tunnel closes. Anyone caught in it when that happens must make a spell save or be trapped in the re-appearing stone and killed.

Those who make their saves are ejected from the closest end of the tunnel.
